steps.caption: The counter 'Total workflows' links straight to the history.
Workflow history, newest first. Each run has a name and a status chip.
The second line: what started it (a person, an event, a schedule), start and finish time, and how many retries.
A completed run lists the steps it did — here, a requirement change re-ran comparisons, scores and notifications.
A failed run says which step failed, in red, with the reason.
Filters: All, Failed, Delayed, Completed and Paused. Choose Failed.
Only failed runs now. Open one to see every step and fix it.
The run page: what went wrong, which records were affected and Retry failed steps.
Back in History, choose Paused to see runs waiting for you to resume or cancel them.
Completed shows everything that finished well. Delayed shows runs that are late.
